caption: The drawing depicts a white quilt draped in a way that shows folds along its surface. The quilt features a repeating geometric pattern composed of red diamond or star-shaped patches outlined in white, interconnected with green vines and stems. Surrounding the red patches are clusters of green leaves, and at the ends of the vines are small red flowers or buds. The border of the quilt is decorated with a winding green vine, also punctuated by small red flowers at various intervals. The entire surface of the quilt is detailed with fine black dotted lines, suggesting quilted stitching. The background of the image is a plain off-white or light beige color.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
